notes.title: 1.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Optimized version for all configs! Go High for 4k assets, or Low if you want to add a player to your game with an older machine!

notes.title: 0.5.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Balance tweaks: an easier time for the thieves at higher player count!
Better volume balance, let's hear Raphael's incredible work on sound design!
Bug fixes

notes.title: Visual Updates
notes.notes:
We're constantly working on improving the visuals and the feel of the game, and in today's update we have a couple improvements to share with you all.

1. New dash/catch VFX for the Blackbirds and the Crosbys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/5b8b3bffed20688a641d1ddb1fed20d5995231b0.gif[/img]

2. New VFX and barking SFX for the small dog

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/4ecb15ae976cb268436c220dfddc1517b591d147.gif[/img]

3. Improved the VFX for jewels to make them more noticeable once dropped

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/77434279d5c5d02f49e44cd394ca511f94e2e664.png[/img]

4. New generated maps

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/6c5067b96ad3f3b6c07ebf5b40f0832b9e8a7747.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/a1c168d68b108df2c9d359bf526f23b5ec27f2d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/3e94cd0dd6d5baa5930c6a0d6d6b41bdbe907dfe.png[/img]



As always, don't forget to add A Good Day to your wishlist to be notified as soon as our game is availab le. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Meet Micheline
notes.notes:
👀It seems like someone else's looks got upgraded...

Meet Micheline, one of the Blackbirds running (or flying?🤔) around the Crosby's garden searching for their precious fruits.💎

This is not her only look though, stay tuned for more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/22a8d178f58d0bbf518a540a8d43c9f0fc9cf914.gif[/img]

notes.title: GRAPHICS OVERHAUL
notes.notes:
We are still working on improving the game graphics which are reaching their final designs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/046cdabee39ef7b63604ff5f4f25797fb3a4c77f.png[/img]


👀Take a look at the evolution of Mr Crosby🐺, a village outcast that will use anything at his disposal to protect his garden and its precious fruits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/a6ebe996258b7e5813e3040c92aa9c120864b955.gif[/img]

The feel of the game is improved with global visual effects and new camera angles to make your experience more enjoyable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/c5d9703b313a854f49520c54326f72ff2baa3394.gif[/img]


Collect jewels and escape Mr Crosby together!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/fe51b66331187a51ecd419392b78defca5489c82.gif[/img]

notes.title: Graphics and gameplay improvements!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/74e13e335200b691bf4202975189e73246771341.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/350c87a9be0cc2625f2743f59897b636e7bfcbfe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/23d9e8e5874af9da888f316d2c30b99202c70717.png[/img]

There is still a lot to come, and we are aiming for a release in Q3 2023, so stay tuned!
